mapper.sql: SELECT attendee_id, record_id, user_id, user_name, dept_id, dept_name, sign_in_status, sign_in_time, sign_in_method, exam_score, is_pass, exam_time, enterprise_id, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM biz_safety_training_attendee

SELECT a.attendee_id, a.record_id, a.user_id, a.user_name, a.dept_id, a.dept_name, a.sign_in_status, a.sign_in_time, a.sign_in_method, a.exam_score, a.is_pass, a.exam_time, a.enterprise_id, a.del_flag, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.remark, r.course_name, r.training_date FROM biz_safety_training_attendee a LEFT JOIN biz_safety_training_record r ON a.record_id = r.record_id
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO biz_safety_training_attendee ( record_id, user_id, user_name, dept_id, dept_name, sign_in_status, sign_in_method, exam_score, is_pass, enterprise_id, create_by, create_time, remark ) VALUES
(#{item.recordId}, #{item.userId}, #{item.userName}, #{item.deptId}, #{item.deptName}, #{item.signInStatus}, #{item.signInMethod}, #{item.examScore}, #{item.isPass}, #{item.enterpriseId}, #{item.createBy}, sysdate(), #{item.remark})
mapper.delete: UPDATE biz_safety_training_attendee SET del_flag = '2' WHERE attendee_id = #{attendeeId}
UPDATE biz_safety_training_attendee SET del_flag = '2' WHERE attendee_id IN #{attendeeId}
mapper.select: WHERE record_id = #{recordId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND del_flag = '0' LIMIT 1
SELECT user_id FROM biz_safety_training_attendee WHERE record_id = #{recordId} AND del_flag = '0'

SELECT MIN(a.attendee_id) AS attendee_id, a.user_id, a.user_name, a.dept_id, a.dept_name, SUM(CASE WHEN r.hours IS NOT NULL THEN r.hours ELSE 0 END) AS total_hours, COUNT(a.attendee_id) AS attend_count, SUM(CASE WHEN a.is_pass = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pass_count FROM biz_safety_training_attendee a LEFT JOIN biz_safety_training_record r ON a.record_id = r.record_id AND r.del_flag = '0' WHERE a.del_flag = '0' AND a.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userName}, '%') AND a.dept_id = #{deptId} AND a.is_pass = #{isPass} AND r.training_date >= #{params.beginTime} AND r.training_date <= #{params.endTime} GROUP BY a.user_id, a.user_name, a.dept_id, a.dept_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN r.hours IS NOT NULL THEN r.hours ELSE 0 END) >= 24
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN r.hours IS NOT NULL THEN r.hours ELSE 0 END) < 24
ORDER BY total_hours DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_safety_training_attendee SET is_pass = #{isPass}, exam_score = #{examScore}, exam_time = #{examTime}, update_time = sysdate() WHERE attendee_id IN #{attendeeId} AND del_flag = '0'
